verified_instances.excerpt: The current text preserves customer access to per-model test results while avoiding general-public publication, and makes >5% a regulator review trigger rather than an automatic sales restriction. S5 retains the 8-per-100,000 threshold for prompt investigation and regulator assessment, with recall available when the evidence warrants it. Please confirm whether Northwind can accept the current version.

Each company's favoured section is weakened in exchange for the other's.
